canonical_title: Object Recognition for Product Identification in Retail Stores
committee: Asst. Prof. Dr. Dobri Atanassov Batovski
abstract: Retail stores are increasingly steering towards smart shelf technology; however, current available smart shelves are expensive to implement and use a variety of complicated sensors and hardware. Our project attempts to prove the feasibility of using only computer vision for object detection in a retail environment to provide cheaper alternatives for smaller retail stores. In our project, we explore multiple computer vision methodologies and implemented MobileNet SSD to detect various products and recognize predefined customer activities at a shelf. This paper describes the overall framework of our system, the preparation and creation of our custom model as well as an analysis of the evaluation results. This report also details the relevant software and hardware specifications as well as the implementation, the cost of implementation, deployment, and environmental setup of our project.

platform.evidence: Section 5.1: alternatives considered 'included a general PC and Raspberry Pi' before the team chose the Jetson Nano.

domain.evidence: The system detects products and predefined customer activities at a shelf in retail and convenience store environments (Chapters 1, 3 and 5).

technology.label: MobileNet SSD
technology.evidence: Section 3.2.3: MobileNet SSD chosen as the model; trained ssd_mobilenet_v1_coco via transfer learning, reaching mAP 0.9999 over 5 products.

technology.label: Haar Cascade classifier
technology.evidence: Section 2.1 literature review covers the Haar Cascade Classifier; it was rejected for low accuracy and dependence on consistent lighting.

technology.label: R-CNN family (Fast/Faster R-CNN)
technology.evidence: Sections 2.2 and 3.2.2 review R-CNN, Fast R-CNN and Faster R-CNN; Faster R-CNN was rejected as computationally expensive.

technology.label: YOLO (Tiny YOLO, YOLOv3)
technology.evidence: Sections 2.3 and 3.2.2 review YOLO variants; rejected because Tiny YOLO has poor accuracy and YOLOv3 is too intensive for single board computers.

canonical_title: Web Classification Chrome Extension POC: Gambling Blocker
aliases: Web Classification Chrome Extension: Gambling Blocker
abstract: Gambling has been a problem in Thailand for a longtime which government cannot entirely fix the people addition in gambling, especially in teenager and working age adult. Because gambling is illegal in Thailand, government and police try to raid and catch gambling though out Thailand but still not effective. That due to gambling website start to gain popularity among Thai gamblers. That popularity also reaches the underage, unlike the adult, underage teen protection because they still not have much experience in these black side of the world. The Problems caused by excessive gambling are not just financial. Too much time spent on gambling can also lead to relationship and legal problems, job loss, bad education grade, mental health problems including depression and anxiety, and even suicide. Some people might say that problems is might not happen because they might get rich from gambling, but that is not the case because most of these gambling websites have the algorithm to get money from user on one way or another. Some websites easily give the money to the user first, so the user will invest more, and they will get a bigger amount of money from user. These websites persuade people to use their website by advertise on illegal free website though out Thailand. A lot of people will encounter these websites a lot because people who don't have much money will try to find alternate way of get the free service, such as watching free movie online website, pornography website and etc.. One of the ways to protect or filter out these websites is using web page classification technique. Our service is an google chrome extension that help block the Thai gambling website using our own custom model to classify which website is gambling website. We use google chrome extension because of two reasons. First due to, parent can easily install the extension without their children acknowledgement. And secondly, majority of Thailand population are using google chrome as their main browser.

platform.evidence: Section 1.2: 'Gambling Blocker is a POC google chrome extension that classify the Thai online gambling website' using a machine learning text-based model.

domain.label: Web content filtering
domain.evidence: Abstract: 'One of the ways to protect or filter out these websites is using web page classification technique', aiming to block Thai gambling sites from underage users.

canonical_title: PROMAI: Promotion Recommendation on E-commerce Application
abstract: In the present day, shopping is the activity that people spend time as a hobby or buying basic needs. Nevertheless, the said activities are usually time-consuming and troublesome for finding the products to help fulfill a promotion and searching for the available promotions. Unexpectedly, the existing e-commerce applications do not aim to solve this pain point. If managed properly, they can undoubtedly boost the products' sales. Promai is an e-commerce application built on an iOS platform that focuses on promotion recommendations and package recommendations for those who do not know what to buy to achieve a promotion. With the various approaches to suggest, it improves the user experience by making it more accessible. Besides, combining with the promotions' progress tracking bars will significantly stimulate their desires to purchase. Furthermore, Promai Pro is provided for the staff to create and manage promotions at their fingertips.

committee: Asst. Prof. Dr. Dobri Atanassov Batovski
abstract: Thailand is well known for its unique culture, numerous forms of activities, as well as carnivals. All these activities have contributed to the tourism economy in Thailand. However, in the marketplace, there is still a lack of a platform that helps people to find festivals around them. Our Nearby Festival application is trying to solve this kind of vacancy by creating a platform that enables travelers to easily find the festivals going around their places.We hope our application can bring a little force in promoting the tourism of Thailand.

abstract: AU Museum website is a web platform that uses the wordpress. Wordpress is a free custom and open source content management system (CMS) that provide thousands of plugins, widgets, and themes. Moreover, AU Museum website requires the system about wordpress, local host, live host, web server, plugin and theme. AU museum website starts with local host "Flywheel" and uploads the necessary contents and images ange content of the webpage. Finally, user interface (UI) of AU Museum website has a home page, about us page, collections; first floor, second floor and third floor, visit us. AU Museum website will be a learning center for AU members such as students, teachers, university staff and other users that are interested in museums. AU Museum website will be one more channel for promoting the historical AU museum, collections in AU museum, events, etc. via website.
